items.title: Uber (UBER) Wins Court Injunction Over New York Driver Deactivation Law
items.summary: A U.S. District Judge granted Uber and Lyft an injunction against a New York City law on driver deactivations. The ruling temporarily blocks new rules that would have limited how the platforms can remove drivers from their apps. The decision affects Uber Technologies' flexibility in managing driver relations and safety policies in a key market.
